text.en:
Section 2, par. 1(s) and (b), is hereby amended to read as follows:
"1. Educational Loan Funds (ELF)
"(a) The Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) and the Social Security System (SSS) shall set aside
Eight Million Pesos (P8,000.000.00) each annually as their yearly contribution to the Educational Loan Fund
from which qualified students may avail educational assistance loans. This fund shall be used to service the
financial needs of eligible students regardless of whether or not their parents of any of them are members of
"(b) The Philippine National Bank, Development Bank of the Philippines, and the Land Bank of the
Philippines shall set aside Eight Million Pesos (P8,000,000.00) each annually as their yearly contributions to
the Educational Loan Fund. These institutions shall submit to the Council the procedural guidelines for their
participation."

Section 2, par. 2(a) of the same Decree is hereby amended to read as follows:
"2. Educational Loan Guarantee Fund (ELGF)
"(a) The sum of Five Million Pesos (P5,000,000.00) is hereby appropriated from the funds of the National
Treasury to constitute the initial Educational Loan Guarantee Fund. For this purpose the Budget
Commissioner shall immediately release the funds herein appropriated to the Department of Education and
Culture. Earnings, guarantee charges and other credits arising from the operations of this Loan Fund shall
accrue to the Educational Loan Guarantee Fund."
Section 6 of the same Decree is hereby amended to read as follows:

An inter-agency secretariat, the composition and functions of which shall be determined by the
Council is hereby created to assist the council in the implementation of this program.
"A sum of Six Hundred Thousand Pesos (P600,000.00) is hereby appropriated annually to be included in the
budget of the Department of Education and Culture to finance the operation and maintenance of the Plan and
the present Educational Assistance Unit which shall henceforth be called the National Educational Loan
Assistance Center to be headed by an Executive Director who shall implement and monitor all plans, policies,

measures, rules and regulations issued by the Council in close coordination with the lending institutions."
Section 4. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-eight.
